title.en: Frank-Egedal hot-ion velocity and pitch moments
title.zh: Frank-Egedal 热离子速度与俯仰矩

summary: Integrate source-mode hot-ion density and gyrotropic pressure moments over speed and trapped pitch, returning dimensionless shapes normalized to the reference-field moments.

identity.relation: Local magnetic-field magnitude and source angular modes to normalized hot-ion density and pressure shapes
identity.direction: (magnetic_field, params, degrees, source_coefficients, legendre_terms, fractional_mode) -> normalized_field, xi_tp_mid, hot_parallel_shape, hot_perpendicular_shape, hot_density_shape, quadrature
identity.definition: Set b=B/B0, xi_tp,mid=sqrt(1-1/mirror_ratio), and xi_tp,loc=sqrt(max(0,1-b/mirror_ratio)). For each b with positive trapped-pitch interval, integrate speed v/v0 in (0,1) and pitch xi in (0,xi_tp,loc) using Gauss--Legendre nodes. The nonnegative distribution is max(sum_j c_j*fractional_mode(degree_j,xi0,legendre_terms)*u(v)^(degree_j*(degree_j+1))/(v^3+vc^3),0), with u(v)=[(1+vc^3)*v^3/(v^3+vc^3)]^(beta_m/3) and xi0=sqrt(clip((xi^2-(1-b))/b,0,xi_tp,mid^2)); the denominator is floored at 1e-30. Density and parallel moments use 4*pi times integrals of v^2*f and v^4*xi^2*f. The perpendicular moment uses 2*pi times the integral of v^4*(1-xi^2)*f, but its speed integral starts at perp_velocity_lower. Divide parallel and perpendicular moments by max(reference parallel moment at b=1,1e-30), and density by max(reference density moment,1e-30).
identity.model: Finite-node Frank-Egedal source-mode hot-ion quadrature and reference-field normalization; not a self-consistent distribution, potential or magnetic equilibrium solver
identity.geometry: A positive two-dimensional local magnetic-field magnitude on caller-supplied [Z,R] samples; no field-line geometry or spatial metric is computed.
identity.coordinates: The input axes and returned shape-field axes are [Z,R]. Speed is normalized by v0; xi is the implementation's nonnegative pitch cosine, and xi0 is mapped to the reference field. B0 is a field magnitude in T; all returned shape fields are dimensionless.
identity.boundary: The local trapped-pitch interval closes at b >= mirror_ratio and returns zero raw moments there. The speed interval is (0,1), except the perpendicular moment uses [perp_velocity_lower,1]; the reference normalization is evaluated separately at b=1.
assumptions: The supplied fractional_mode and coefficients describe the same source and angular-mode convention; this function does not verify their physical derivation.
mirror_ratio is the preferred configuration key; turning_b is read only when mirror_ratio is absent. beta_m is preferred over zeff/2, and perp_velocity_lower defaults to vc_over_v0.
The pressure and density moments are shape factors, not pressures in Pa or number densities in m^-3; a separate assembly must supply physical scales.

inputs.name: magnetic_field
inputs.shape: [N_Z,N_R] two-dimensional array; an empty axis is accepted when an explicit valid B0 is supplied
inputs.constraints: Every present value finite and strictly positive; B0 must also be positive. Without explicit B0 an empty field yields an invalid reference median.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Configuration read by mapping get: B0, mirror_ratio or turning_b, vc_over_v0, perp_velocity_lower, beta_m or zeff, velocity_nodes and pitch_nodes.
inputs.units: B0: T; ratios and beta_m: dimensionless; nodes: count
inputs.dtype: mapping with get and numeric-convertible selected values
inputs.constraints: B0 defaults to nanmedian(B); mirror_ratio defaults to 2 and must be finite >1; vc_over_v0 defaults to 0.25 and must be finite >=0; perp_velocity_lower defaults to vc_over_v0 and must be in [0,1]; beta_m defaults to zeff/2 with zeff default 1 and must be finite; both node counts default to 24 and int-convert to at least 2. Unused keys are ignored.

inputs.name: degrees
inputs.description: Fractional angular-mode degrees paired with source_coefficients.
inputs.constraints: Finite; exactly the same shape as source_coefficients. No degree-range check is performed.

inputs.name: source_coefficients
inputs.constraints: Finite and exactly the same shape as degrees; sign is not restricted.

inputs.name: legendre_terms
inputs.description: Retained term count passed through to fractional_mode.
inputs.dtype: not converted or validated by this operator
inputs.constraints: Passed unchanged to each mode call; the supplied callable owns its validity checks.

inputs.name: fractional_mode
inputs.description: Angular-mode evaluator called as fractional_mode(degree, xi0, legendre_terms).
inputs.shape: callable returning values broadcast-compatible with the speed-by-pitch quadrature grid
inputs.dtype: callable; returned values participate in float-array arithmetic
inputs.constraints: No preflight callable or finite-output check; exceptions, shape errors and nonfinite mode values may propagate.

outputs.name: normalized_field
outputs.description: Input B divided by selected reference B0.
outputs.constraints: Positive and finite on validated finite inputs.

outputs.name: xi_tp_mid
outputs.constraints: Strictly between zero and one for a valid finite mirror_ratio >1.

outputs.name: hot_parallel_shape
outputs.description: Parallel pressure moment divided by the reference parallel moment.
outputs.constraints: Uses a 1e-30 denominator floor; zero raw moment for b >= mirror_ratio. At b=1 it equals one when the reference moment is at least the floor.

outputs.name: hot_perpendicular_shape
outputs.description: Perpendicular pressure moment divided by the reference parallel, not perpendicular, moment.
outputs.constraints: Uses the same 1e-30 reference parallel denominator floor; zero when perp_velocity_lower=1 or b >= mirror_ratio.

outputs.name: hot_density_shape
outputs.description: Density moment divided by the reference density moment.
outputs.constraints: Uses a 1e-30 denominator floor; zero raw moment for b >= mirror_ratio. At b=1 it equals one when the reference moment is at least the floor.

outputs.name: quadrature
outputs.description: Used speed and pitch Gauss--Legendre node counts, not nodes or error estimates.

preconditions: The 2D field and reference scale use the same T convention; the mode evaluator and source coefficients implement a compatible angular expansion.
Positive finite field, mirror ratio greater than one and quadrature counts of at least two are supplied or obtained by defaults.
supported: Finite-node normalized hot-ion pressure and density shapes on a [Z,R] field grid.
A selectable lower speed bound for only the perpendicular moment and caller-supplied fractional angular modes.
excluded: Physical pressure or density scaling, a self-consistent magnetic or electrostatic equilibrium, and automatic source-mode construction.
A proven exact pitch spectrum, convergence/error estimate for finite quadrature, arbitrary velocity distributions or negative-pitch branch integration.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-2D/nonfinite field, nonpositive B or B0, invalid mirror_ratio, vc_over_v0, perp_velocity_lower, beta_m, too few quadrature nodes, or nonfinite/mismatched mode arrays. Conversion or missing mapping methods may raise TypeError, ValueError or AttributeError; the callable and legendre_terms are not prevalidated.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: fractional_mode exceptions, incompatible return shapes and quadrature/arithmetic errors propagate. Mode sums and integrals have no general finite-output check; negative distribution values are clipped to zero, while nonfinite mode values may produce nonfinite shapes or warnings.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iterative solve; fixed Gauss--Legendre quadrature has no convergence flag or error estimate.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result mapping is returned on an exception. A successful mapping contains all six named fields, including zero shapes where the trapped interval closes.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel maintains a hot-ion-moment implementation associated with a saved historical Pleiades Frank-Egedal extraction and migration mapping. Those development records are not a newly qualified L1 delivery or current expert recognition; the maintained callable and direct SciRel tests define the stated development contract.
source_kinds: saved historical Pleiades operator description and implementation mapping
SciRel direct quadrature, independent reference-integral and boundary tests

example.description: Use a constant angular mode to check reference normalization and the closed trapped interval at the mirror ratio.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.frank_egedal_hot_ion_moments import evaluate_frank_egedal_hot_ion_moments
def mode(degree, xi, terms):
    return np.ones_like(xi)
r = evaluate_frank_egedal_hot_ion_moments([[1.0, 4.0]], {'B0': 1.0, 'mirror_ratio': 4.0, 'vc_over_v0': 0.5, 'velocity_nodes': 8, 'pitch_nodes': 8}, [0.5], [1.0], 15, mode)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['normalized_field'], [[1.0, 4.0]])
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['hot_parallel_shape'], [[1.0, 0.0]])
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['hot_density_shape'], [[1.0, 0.0]])
assert r['hot_perpendicular_shape'][0, 0] > 0.0
assert r['hot_perpendicular_shape'][0, 1] == 0.0
assert r['quadrature'] == {'velocity_nodes': 8, 'pitch_nodes': 8}
example.expected: B/B0 is [1,4]; reference parallel and density shapes are one, the closed trapped interval has zero shapes, and the two configured quadrature counts are returned.

scope: A selected nonconstant angular mode at B=1 is compared to independent adaptive speed and pitch integrals at two degrees, with rtol=2e-12 for the resulting normalized moments.
The perpendicular lower-speed bound is compared with its default for one positive-field case.
An incomplete call is rejected; the documented example exercises reference normalization and a closed trapped interval.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests establish selected B=1 quadrature identities and sensitivity to one perpendicular integration bound. They do not prove all field values, mode families, quadrature convergence, source-code parity for a currently qualified L1 bundle, physical validity of the Frank-Egedal model, expert recognition or public release.
known_limitations: The source and maintained graph YAML have historical configuration prose that differs on mirror_ratio versus turning_b precedence; this exact callable uses mirror_ratio first.
The finite-node quadrature returns no error estimate; the 1e-30 floors and negative-distribution clipping can mask degenerate mode configurations.
A rounded-b local cache can reuse values within 12 decimal digits, and no output finiteness guarantee is made for a misbehaving fractional_mode.
Current-version expert recognition and public distribution licensing remain pending.
